entities.name: Albert Kalonji
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Albert Kalonji was a Congolese politician and businessman from the Luba ya Kasai nobility. He was elected emperor (Mulopwe) of the Baluba ya Kasai (Bambo) and later became king of the Federated State of South Kasai.
